capsule_signed_axis_displacement_definit: Acceptance _walk starts at the authored doorway centre and reports (final_world_position - doorway_centre).dot(outward_world). Positive means the capsule stayed outside; negative means it advanced inside. A value below -0.60m passes the open or detached-door entry test. This is a signed travel coordinate, not doorway clear width.
parts_manifest_semantics: The current parts[] table inventories individual renderable mesh nodes. DoorUnit is separately declared by door_unit_node and exists once per GLB; WindowUnit_NN nodes are real imported composite nodes but are not individually enumerated in parts[]. Use the names verified here, not a claim that parts[] alone exposes the whole assembly.
runtime_collision_exact_scope: ShellCollision trimesh from actual BuildingShell; DoorCollision box under moving DoorPivot; one WindowCollision_NN pane box under each movable WindowSash_NN; merchant-only ShopBayPostCollision with two boxes from manifest centres x=-2.45/+2.45, Blender y=-4.75,z=1.35,size0.14x0.5x2.5m. The component does not create collision bodies for the manifest's timber and roof candidate entries.

operation.instantiate: Create ModularHouseComponent, set variant_id, add to scene; build_on_ready defaults true or call build() once. res:// paths are relative to game/ as Godot project root.
operation.door: set_door_open(bool)/interact_door() use the manifest 88 degree hinge angle; detach_door_unit() returns the complete live DoorUnit. install_door_unit(Node3D) requires detached DoorFrame, DoorPivot, DoorLeaf and DoorCollision descendants and aligns it to the authored anchor. The unchanged shell aperture remains; a rotated cross-variant same-size unit transplant was physically verified.
operation.oak_leaf: external_door_visual_path defaults to the root-owned oak door GLB and only replaces the visible leaf. clear_external_door_visual() restores the authored fallback; it never replaces the full door physical assembly.
operation.window: set_window_open(bool) lifts all sashes by0.715m and swings paired shutters to +/-75 degrees. To detach one complete unit, find WindowUnit_NN in instance, retain its parent/transform, remove_child(unit), and add_child(unit) with original transform to restore. One front unit per variant was physically verified; there is no dedicated cross-variant custom-window replacement API.
operation.roof: roof_node() exposes a separate visual Roof node for callers to hide/remove; no independent runtime roof collision is currently authored.

explicit_remaining_scope: These DoorUnit/WindowUnit nodes belong to newly authored three modular replacement GLBs; the separate 32 Meshy LOD exterior houses are visual exteriors and have not been automatically semantic-segmented into independently operable doors/windows.

Complete cross-variant custom WindowUnit transplant and arbitrary window-size replacement have not been demonstrated; current proof is each original unit's real detach/reinstall and sash/shutter motion.
Upper-floor stairs/furnishing, turret interior entry, persistent housing/inventory and NPC interactions are outside this module delivery.
